title: Approximate continuity of the density gives the blow-up density hypothesis (Remark 5.6(iii))
statement: Assume DensityExistsAE (Simon 8.3.6). If V is an n-varifold on open U ⊆ ℝ^N with locally bounded first variation, then for μ_V-a.e. x the following holds. For all real θ0 and τ with Θ^n(μ_V, x) = ofReal θ0 and τ < θ0: ρ^{-n} μ_V({y ∈ B_ρ(x) : not (Θ^n(μ_V, y) exists and is ≥ ofReal τ)}) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0.
lean_statement: DensityExistsAE → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∀ θ₀ τ : ℝ, HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal θ₀) → τ < θ₀ → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ V.weight {y | y ∈ closedBall x ρ ∧ ¬ ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n V.weight y θ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal τ ≤ θ} / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
